root.name: wflow
root.description: Monorepo hosting a CLI tool and a Claude Code plugin for an ICM-inspired workflow.
root.archStyle: Monorepo containing a CLI tool and a Claude Code plugin distributed together.

subcomponents.name: claude-plugin
subcomponents.description: The Claude Code plugin distributing wflow's skills.
subcomponents.archStyle: Claude Code plugin exposing a set of skills.

subcomponents.name: tool
subcomponents.archStyle: Command-line tool with both a traditional command-based interface and a TUI that exposes some functionalities for the wflow system.

$uncategorized.label: Unified topic exposure
$uncategorized.content: Expose wflow's functionality as a set of topics (e.g. Home, Archiver), reachable from both a command-based CLI and an interactive TUI shell.

$uncategorized.label: Stash & restore
$uncategorized.content: Allow stashing the active run into the archive, and restoring a previously archived run back as the active run.

$uncategorized.label: No silent run loss
$uncategorized.content: Restoring a run must never erase an active run; swapping the active run for another is allowed, but no run may be discarded silently.

$uncategorized.label: Confirm mutating actions
$uncategorized.content: Require explicit user confirmation before performing any mutating operation on runs (stash, restore, ...).

usability.label: Actionable errors
usability.content: Report failures with a clear message and a suggested next action (no active run, unknown run id, archive out of sync).

subcomponents.name: wflow-cli
subcomponents.description: Classic command-based cli side of the tool that exposes the topic
subcomponents.archStyle: Yargs-powered cli app that exposes the topics.

$uncategorized.label: TUI launch mode
$uncategorized.content: Simple commands (bare wflow, `home`, `archiver`) launch the TUI on the corresponding tab.

$uncategorized.label: Headless mode
$uncategorized.content: Other subcommands (e.g. under `archiver`) run headlessly instead of opening the TUI (see cli-archiver).

$uncategorized.label: Shell completion
$uncategorized.content: Provide commands to print and install a shell completion script, skipping install if already present.

usability.label: CLI failure reporting
usability.content: On failure, print a clear message and exit with a non-zero status code.

subcomponents.name: cli-archiver
subcomponents.description: CLI-specific implementation of the archiver commands, wrapping the archiver-topic library.
subcomponents.archStyle: Yargs subcommand handlers over archiver-topic, for headless (non-TUI) usage.

$uncategorized.label: Headless archive command
$uncategorized.content: Provide `archiver archive`, which stashes the active run without opening the TUI.

$uncategorized.label: Headless restore command
$uncategorized.content: Provide `archiver restore <run-id>` to restore a run headlessly, with --auto-archive to stash the active run first (a no-op if none is active).

$uncategorized.label: Archive output format
$uncategorized.content: Print the archived run's id and the list of moved units, or "(nothing to move)" if none.

$uncategorized.label: Restore output format
$uncategorized.content: Print the auto-archived run's id first, if any, then the restored run's id.

subcomponents.name: wflow-tui
subcomponents.archStyle: Ink-based (React) application that exposes the topics with a TUI.

$uncategorized.label: Topic switching
$uncategorized.content: Left/right arrow keys cycle between registered topic tabs, wrapping around at either end.

$uncategorized.label: Non-TTY fail-fast
$uncategorized.content: Fail fast with a clear error when the TUI is launched outside an interactive terminal (non-TTY stdin).

$uncategorized.label: Quit shortcut
$uncategorized.content: Pressing Escape or 'q' exits the TUI from anywhere in the shell.

$uncategorized.label: Nested input priority
$uncategorized.content: A topic's own input handling (e.g. a confirm prompt) takes priority over the shell's global tab-switching/quit keys.

subcomponents.name: archiver-topic
subcomponents.description: Functionality that displays active and stashed runs, if present, and allows to both stash and restore specific ones.
subcomponents.archStyle: Set of functions that perform the necessary readings and movements of run files.

$uncategorized.label: Detect active run
$uncategorized.content: Determine whether a run is currently active in the workspace, and expose its run id if so.

$uncategorized.label: List archived runs
$uncategorized.content: List the ids of all currently archived (stashed) runs, ordered alphabetically.

$uncategorized.label: Stash implementation
$uncategorized.content: Move the active run's output units and run.json into archive/<run-id>/, emptying the live layers.

$uncategorized.label: Restore implementation
$uncategorized.content: Move an archived run's output units and run.json back into the live layers from archive/<run-id>/.

$uncategorized.label: run.json identity
$uncategorized.content: A run is identified by a run.json (validated against run.schema.json) whose run.id names it.

$uncategorized.label: Archive layout
$uncategorized.content: The live run sits under stages/; each archived run sits under archive/<run-id>/, whose folder name must match its run.json's run.id.

usability.label: Shared across CLI & TUI
usability.content: This library must be usable identically from both the CLI (COM-004) and the TUI (COM-005), with no consumer-specific logic embedded in it.

availabilityAndReliability.label: No partial mutations
availabilityAndReliability.content: Mutating operations must not leave the workspace in a partially-moved, inconsistent state if interrupted.
